(()=>{const d=document.querySelector('.horovitz-svg').dataset;if(Number(d.horovitzResult)!==300||document.querySelector('[data-horovitz-group=oxygen]').innerHTML!==window.o2||document.querySelector('[data-horovitz-group=pao2]').innerHTML===window.pa||document.querySelector('.result-number').textContent!=='300')throw Error('PaO2 sensitivity');return 'Only PaO2: both pressure columns rise, oxygen mix stays fixed';})()

(()=>{const d=document.querySelector('.horovitz-svg').dataset;if(Number(d.horovitzResult)!==100||document.querySelector('[data-horovitz-group=pao2]').innerHTML!==window.pa||document.querySelector('[data-horovitz-group=oxygen]').innerHTML===window.o2||document.querySelector('.result-number').textContent!=='100')throw Error('FiO2 sensitivity');return 'Only FiO2: mix widens and P/F drops, measured PaO2 stays fixed';})()

(()=>{const d=document.querySelector('.horovitz-svg').dataset;if(d.horovitzPaHeight!==d.horovitzResultHeight||Number(d.horovitzResult)!==80||document.querySelector('[data-horovitz-group=rest]').innerHTML!=='')throw Error('Pure oxygen identity');return '100%: equal pressure heights and no fictitious remaining gas';})()
(()=>{if(Number(document.querySelector('.horovitz-svg').dataset.horovitzResult)!==200)throw Error('Equal scaling');return 'Both inputs doubled: quotient unchanged at 200';})()

(()=>{if(Math.abs(Number(document.querySelector('#anatomy-pao2').value.replace(',','.'))-80/7.50062)>1e-8)throw Error('kPa conversion');return 'Main pressure selector converts and synchronizes kPa';})()

(()=>{const e=document.querySelector('#anatomy-fio2').closest('.horovitz-input').querySelector('[type=range]');if(e.min!=='0.21'||e.max!=='1'||e.step!=='0.01')throw Error('Fraction slider bounds');const d=document.querySelector('.horovitz-svg').dataset;if(Math.abs(Number(d.horovitzResult)-200)>1e-6||Math.abs(Number(d.horovitzOxygenWidth)-Number(window.base.horovitzOxygenWidth))>1e-6)throw Error('Unit changed geometry');return 'Both alternative units preserve physical values, P/F and slider limits';})()

(()=>{if(document.querySelector('#field-pao2').value!=='10'||Math.abs(Number(document.querySelector('.horovitz-svg').dataset.horovitzResult)-187.5155)>1e-5)throw Error('kPa input');return '10 kPa is 75.0062 mmHg; index 187.5155';})()

(()=>{if(Math.abs(Number(document.querySelector('#field-pao2').value.replace(',','.'))-10.1)>1e-8||Math.abs(Number(document.querySelector('#field-fio2').value.replace(',','.'))-.51)>1e-8)throw Error('Selected-unit keyboard step');return 'Knob keyboard steps respect .1 kPa and .01 fraction';})()

(()=>{if(document.querySelector('#field-pao2').closest('.input-wrap').querySelector('select').value!=='0'||document.querySelector('#anatomy-fio2').closest('.input-wrap').querySelector('select').value!=='0')throw Error('Unit reverse sync');return 'Reverse conversions synchronize both controls';})()

(()=>{if(Number(document.querySelector('.horovitz-svg').dataset.horovitzFio2)<=40||document.querySelector('#field-fio2').value!==document.querySelector('#anatomy-fio2').value)throw Error('Mix drag');return 'Direct mix knob drag updates shared FiO2';})()

(()=>{if(Number(document.querySelector('.horovitz-svg').dataset.horovitzPao2)<=80||document.querySelector('#field-pao2').value!==document.querySelector('#anatomy-pao2').value)throw Error('Pressure drag');return 'Direct pressure knob drag updates shared PaO2';})()

(()=>{if(document.querySelector('.result-number').textContent!=='—'||document.querySelector('[data-horovitz-group=result]').style.display!=='none')throw Error('Invalid stale result');return 'Invalid input clears both readouts and moving parts';})()

(()=>{if(document.documentElement.scrollWidth>innerWidth)throw Error('Horizontal overflow');const r=document.querySelector('[data-horovitz-handle=fio2]').getBoundingClientRect();if(r.width<43.9||r.height<43.9)throw Error('Small pointer target');return 'Reset, example, layout and 44px control targets pass';})()
